name: Morse.tangentSubspace
why: Project: range of mfderiv of the inclusion N -> V for the slice-submanifold manifold structure. Blind: span of velocities gamma'(0) of curves C^infty on some (-eps, eps), valued in N, gamma(0) = q. Equal for every slice submanifold and q, with no extra hypothesis: via Morse.tangentSubspace_eq_range_fderiv_sliceParam, x'(z0) a is the velocity of t -> x(z0 + t a), and conversely a curve in N equals x o c near 0 with c = (phi o gamma).1 (slice condition), so gamma'(0) = x'(z0)(c'(0)). The blind span is thus superfluous (the velocities already form the subspace).
